The activity set will not apply to a specific group of people.
The activity set will not apply to any employees.

questions.explanation: When the Audience field on an activity set is left empty, the activity set applies to all employees in the lifecycle event. Setting an audience restricts which subject persons the activity set targets.

questions.stem: Which base instance application delivers the results of current state metrics?
questions.explanation: HR Dashboards and Reports delivers current-state metrics through predefined dashboards (Overview, Case, Manager) and HR reports in the base instance. Performance Analytics requires an additional subscription and focuses on trend/historical data, not current-state snapshots.

questions.stem: After an HRSD implementation, what capabilities exist for a System Administrator attempting to impersonate an HR member once the HR Admin role has been removed? (Choose two.)

options.text: System Admin can grant scoped HR roles.
System Admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information.
System Admin cannot grant scoped HR roles.
System Admin cannot view HR Cases and confidential profile information.

questions.explanation: After HR Admin role is removed from System Admin, A=System Admin retains platform-level ability to grant scoped HR roles via user management; D=System Admin cannot view HR Cases or confidential profile information — impersonating an HR user does not make HR information visible.

questions.stem: Which application delivers employees an omni-channel learning experience to enable timely access to the correct learning?
questions.explanation: Learning Posts delivers an omni-channel learning experience, providing employees timely access to online courses. Journey tasks of type 'Learning' are only available when Learning Posts is installed. Listening Posts handles pulse surveys; Manager Hub and Employee Relations serve different purposes.

questions.stem: If an HR Service needs to be accessible to employees on the Employee Center, which field must be completed on the HR Service record?
questions.explanation: The Record Producer field must be completed on the HR Service record to make the service accessible to employees on the Employee Center (self-service). The record producer defines the catalog item employees see and submit requests through.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of Journey designer?

options.text: It tracks the progress of Lifecycle Events and onboarding cases using the dashboards.
It passes information from the lifecycle event case to a child case or task
It manages the dependencies of activities within an activity set.
It combines Lifecycle Event cases and Journey Accelerator action plans.

questions.explanation: Journey Designer combines Lifecycle Event cases with Journey Accelerator action plans into a unified employee experience, giving managers and employees a single view of both LE-driven activities and action plan tasks.

questions.stem: Which HRSD application synchronizes ServiceNow with external HR systems?
questions.explanation: HR Integrations synchronizes ServiceNow with external HR systems such as Workday, pulling employee data for time-off requests, job changes, terminations, and other HR events. Lifecycle Events automates internal workflows; Core HR is the data model; Employee Center Pro is a portal.

questions.stem: Which content delivery feature will allow a user to deliver messages to employees and invite them to a meeting where survey results will be shared?
questions.explanation: Campaigns deliver messages to employees and support meeting invitations where survey results are shared. They are the content delivery mechanism for multi-channel employee communications including email, SMS, and portal posts. Journey Accelerator creates plans; Listening Posts creates surveys; Scheduling is not a feature name.

questions.stem: Which learning task template field allows creation of the short description and description in one or more languages?
questions.explanation: The 'Use global descriptions for translations' field on the learning task template enables creation of short description and description in one or more languages. When selected, translations can be provided per language for the task template fields.

questions.stem: With the I18N: Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2 enabled, how are translated Knowledge articles associated with each other so that the user is presented with the article in the selected language?
questions.explanation: With the Knowledge Management Internationalization Plugin v2 enabled, translated Knowledge articles are associated via the Translated Versions related list on the knowledge article form, allowing the system to present the article in the user's preferred language.

questions.stem: Which base instance application delivers the results of current state metrics?
questions.explanation: HR Reports (HR Dashboards and Reports) is the base instance application delivering current-state metrics through predefined reports and dashboards. Performance Analytics requires a separate subscription for trend data; Employee Center is a portal; HR Integrations handles external system connections.

questions.stem: Which scoped table is an extension of the Task table and allow only users with approved roles to access it?
questions.explanation: HR Core Case [sn_hr_core_case] is a scoped table that extends the Task table and restricts access to only users with approved HR scoped roles (such as sn_hr_core.case_reader or sn_hr_core.case_writer). The other options are plugins or unrelated applications, not scoped task table extensions.

questions.stem: Which feature prevents editing or purging of employee documents based on an HR Profile?
questions.explanation: Legal Holds prevent the editing or purging of employee documents based on an HR profile. All documents under legal hold are not purged based on retention policy. Retention Policies define retention periods; Security Policies control access; Topic Detail categorizes documents.

questions.stem: Which field on the Knowledge form categorizes the Knowledge record within the Knowledge base?
questions.explanation: The Category picker field on the Knowledge article form categorizes the knowledge record within the Knowledge base. This field maps the article to a category in the KB hierarchy. Knowledge taxonomy, Article organizer, and Topic categories related list are not the field name for this purpose.

questions.stem: In terms of bulk cases what Status label is given to a User that no longer matches the criteria defined in User Segments?
questions.explanation: 'Excluded' is the status label for users who no longer match the criteria defined in User Segments — the system does not create a case for them. 'Included' means criteria matched; 'Duplicate' means duplicate record; 'Inactive' is not a valid bulk case status.

questions.stem: What type of information does the HR Profile contain?
questions.explanation: The HR Profile contains personal employee data including position, home address, employment dates, salary, and other HR-specific information. User ID and department information reside on the sys_user record. Employee skills and ER cases are stored in separate tables.

questions.stem: What happens when a cross-scope attempt is executed?

options.text: The record is automatically added to the Restricted Caller Access Privileges table
The record is automatically set to caller tracking
The Read record status is set to requested before the system will allow the script to run
The record status is automatically set to allowed

questions.explanation: When a cross-scope access attempt is executed, the Read record status is set to 'Requested' — the system creates a tracking record requiring admin review before the script is allowed to run in production. The record is not automatically added, set to Tracking, or allowed.

questions.stem: What are the advantages of removing the HR Admin role from the system Admin role after the HR Implementation tasks have been completed? (Choose two.)

options.text: Confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR role
HR has control over further HR configurations
System Admin can still grant scoped HR roles
System admin can view HR Cases and confidential profile information

questions.explanation: Advantages of removing HR Admin from System Admin: A=confidential HR data is only accessible to users with an HR scoped role, and B=HR has sole control over further HR configurations (separation of duties). System Admin losing HR Admin cannot grant scoped HR roles or view HR data.

questions.stem: What are the functions of a journey template owner? (Choose three.)

options.text: Restrict inter-departmental transfer of sensitive case details
Manage the order and flow of the journey stages and tasks
Create task templates for their audience in a simple user-friendly experience
Message new hire to welcome them to the team
Change only the task templates that they own

questions.explanation: Journey template owners B=manage order and flow of journey stages and tasks, C=create task templates for their audience, and E=can only change templates they own. A=Restricting inter-departmental transfers is not an owner function; D=Messaging new hires is not a template management responsibility.

questions.stem: What are the configurations for the activity set that is triggered by a date field to not trigger if the date field is empty?

options.text: Add a script to the activity set definition
Select the ignore empty date box.

questions.explanation: To prevent a date-triggered activity set from triggering when the date field is empty, select the 'Ignore empty date' checkbox on the activity set definition. No scripting or rescind link is needed for this purpose.

questions.stem: What does the template field referenced on the HR Service record do?

options.text: Populate fields on a Journey task
Populate fields on the HR Profile
Populate fields on the HR Case record

questions.explanation: The Template field on the HR Service record references an HR case template that automatically populates fields on the HR case form when a request for that service is made. It does not populate Journey tasks, HR agent responses, or HR Profile fields.

questions.stem: Which option allows a user to make a copy of a campaign?
questions.explanation: Clone Campaign is the option that allows a user to make a copy of an existing campaign. User Campaign, Copy Campaign, and Update Campaign are not valid campaign action names in the Content Automation module.

questions.stem: As part of the implementation for an HR Enterprise customer, a new Lifecycle Event for a leave of absence was created. What additional item must be configured in order to initiate the leave of absence Lifecycle Event process for an employee?

options.text: An acceptance from an HR Agent

questions.explanation: After configuring the Lifecycle Event and its activity sets, an HR Service with Fulfillment type set to Lifecycle Event must be created to expose and initiate the LE process for employees. Without the HR Service, the LE has no trigger mechanism.

questions.stem: If the customer has enabled Lifecycle Enterprise, in which Application Scope should they create new Lifecycle Events that will task teams throughout their organization?
questions.explanation: New Lifecycle Events that task teams throughout the organization should be created in the Human Resources: Lifecycle Enterprise application scope, which is the scope of the com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent plugin. Integrations, Service Portal, and Core are not the correct scopes for enterprise lifecycle events.

questions.stem: Which of the following applications allow administrators to create templates that enable managers to develop transition plans for employees?
questions.explanation: Journey Accelerator allows administrators to create audience-specific templates that enable managers to develop transition plans and action plans for employees. Lifecycle Events manages LE workflows; Workflows and Flow Designer are general automation tools, not manager plan builders.

questions.stem:
The customer you are implementing has purchased HR Service Delivery Enterprise which includes Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions.

Which of the following plugins must be activated to enable Lifecycle Events?

options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]

questions.explanation: To enable Lifecycle Events (Enterprise Onboarding and Transitions), the Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent] plugin must be activated. It installs both the LE for Enterprise app and the PA Content Pack for HR LE.

questions.stem: Which HRSD application limits agent tasking only within the HR department?
questions.explanation: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events] limits agent tasking within the HR department only. Lifecycle Events for Enterprise extends tasks cross-departmentally. HR Performance Analytics handles metrics; Employee Center is a portal; neither tasks agents.

questions.stem: What method is used to set policies that determines how long documents are retained and who is covered?

options.text: Create a new policy trough COE Security
Create a new policy using ACLs
Go through Employee Documents > Document Type
Go through HR Service Template > Document Type

questions.explanation: Retention policies — defining how long documents are retained and who is covered — are set through Employee Documents > Document Type configuration. Document types associate with retention policies, COEs, and topic categories. HR Service Template does not contain document retention settings.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow security feature allows access to applications and modules?
questions.explanation: Roles are the security feature that grants users access to applications and modules. Users are assigned roles that control which navigation modules and applications they can access. Scoped Application defines data isolation; Simple Security is not a standard ServiceNow feature; User Authentication verifies identity.

questions.stem: When testing a lifecycle event, you deselected certain cards. When running the test, what does the system do with the activities that were deselected?

options.text: The activity wit be skipped for all future lifecycle events
The activity will be created and automatically cancelled for the test
The activity will be created and must be manually closed for the test
The activity will be skipped for the test

questions.explanation: When testing a lifecycle event and deselecting activity cards in the test tool, those activities are skipped for all future lifecycle events — deselecting marks them as excluded from the lifecycle event configuration.

questions.stem: Which plugin allows agent tasking only within the HR department?

options.text: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events]
Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events for Enterprise [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_ent]
Human Resources Scoped App: Employee Relations [com.sn_hr_employee_relations]

questions.explanation: Human Resources Scoped App: Lifecycle Events [com.sn_hr_lifecycle_events] limits agent tasking within the HR department only. Lifecycle Events for Enterprise (C) extends tasking cross-departmentally. HR Integrations (A) handles third-party connections; Employee Relations (D) manages ER cases.

questions.stem: Which feature enables agents to have discussions about their work in the Next Experience user interface?
questions.explanation: Sidebar overview is the Next Experience UI feature that enables agents to have discussions about their work within HR cases. Agents can start discussions, add participants, and generate summaries. Work Notes are internal case notes, not collaborative discussion threads.

questions.stem: What role, at a minimum, is required to configure an HR integration source?
questions.explanation: Integrations Admin [sn_hr_integrations.admin] is the minimum role required to configure an HR integration source. HR Admin and HR Manager roles do not include integration configuration permissions scoped to the HR Integrations application; HR Basic is a read-only role.

questions.stem: Which application is used to analyze trends, patterns, and data on the Team Insights page?
questions.explanation: Manager Hub is the application used to analyze trends, patterns, and data on the Team Insights page. It integrates with Proactive Prompts for Team Insights and provides team briefs, growth plans, and performance data for managers.

questions.stem: Which feature allows HR Administrators to define when surveys are sent?
questions.explanation: Listening Posts allows HR Administrators to configure when pulse surveys are delivered to employees, including delivery timing, triggers, and scheduling. Standard HR surveys use trigger conditions; Listening Posts specifically governs pulse survey delivery configuration.

questions.stem: Which feature of Lifecycle Events will revert an already completed activity such as the workplace setup?
questions.explanation: Rescind Activity Set is the feature that reverts already completed activities such as workplace setup. It contains rescind activities each linked to the specific activity to undo. Rescind Hire, Undo Activities, and Activity Container are not valid HRSD Lifecycle Event feature names for this purpose.

questions.stem: The HR Integrations application works very similarly to any other integration in the ServiceNow platform, however its application scope only allows users with the appropriate HR roles to access its information. In which Application Scope is HR Integrations?
questions.explanation: The HR Integrations application resides in the Human Resources: Integrations application scope. This scoped boundary ensures only users with appropriate HR roles can access integration data and configuration.

questions.stem: Which module allows administrators to restrict access to specific HR Services without creating ACL records?
questions.explanation: COE Security Configuration allows administrators to restrict read/write access to specific HR Services by group, without creating individual ACL records. Conditions, services, and groups are configured in one policy record. Client-Side Masking and COE Encryption are not the correct module.

questions.stem: If Advanced is selected for an Activity Set Trigger Condition, what additional field(s) become visible?
questions.explanation: When Advanced is selected as the Activity Set Trigger Condition, the Trigger script field becomes visible, enabling administrators to write custom server-side logic controlling when the activity set triggers. Activity Type, Date offset type, and Activity set dependencies do not appear with Advanced selection.

questions.stem: Which feature allows a user to transfer tasks related to Employee Relocation Approvals to another user?
questions.explanation: Granular Delegation allows transfer of tasks (including Employee Relocation Approvals) to another user based on delegation rules defined by table and condition. Audience targets activity recipients; Rescind Activity Set reverts activities; Roles and Groups control access, not task delegation.

questions.stem: Which application is used to send prompts to managers and employees in their flow of work?
questions.explanation: Proactive Prompts sends micro-action prompts to managers and employees in their flow of work through messaging channels including Employee Center, Microsoft Teams, and Slack, driving engagement and timely actions.

questions.stem: How are conditions applied to all HR services when configuring a record on the COE Security Configuration module?

options.text: Select the 'Applies to all services' box
Write a new ACL record for each HR service
Add a filter condition for each HR service
Select each HR service using the services list

questions.explanation: Selecting the 'Applies to all services' checkbox on a COE security policy record applies the policy to all HR services under that COE at once, eliminating the need to select each service individually.

questions.stem: Which content delivery feature will allow a user to deliver messages to employees to encourage them to complete their assigned surveys, track survey completions, and invite them to a meeting where survey results will be shared?
questions.explanation: Campaigns deliver messages to employees, track survey completions, and support meeting invitations to share results — all as part of multi-channel content delivery. Listening Posts creates the surveys; Lifecycle Events and Journey Accelerator are workflow/planning tools, not content delivery features.

questions.stem: When using Agent workspace for Case Management, how can the maximum default size of 30MB for an Employee Document be changed?

options.text: Using the maximum file upload size in megabytes Security policy
Using the file upload size system property
Using the maximum file upload size in megabytes field in the Employee Document Properties
Using the maximum file upload size business rule

questions.explanation: The maximum document upload size (default 30MB) is changed via the 'Maximum file upload size in megabytes' field in Employee Document Properties (sn_hr_ef.max_file_size). This is not a security policy field, business rule, or general system property.

Which caller access option is set by default for HR tables?
questions.explanation: Caller Restriction is the default caller access option set for HR tables — the production-phase setting that blocks unauthorized cross-scope access. Caller Tracking is the development-stage option; Caller Denial and Caller Allowed are not the default settings.
